renders._yaml:
- component: card
  id: sequence_classes
  title: Sequences by Tiara class
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of sequences Tiara classified, with the number of assemblies beside it, and the bar splits them by class (eukarya, bacteria, archaea, prokarya, mitochondrion, plastid or unknown). It answers how much of an assembly is the expected organism and how much is foreign or organellar.
    How to read: in a eukaryotic assembly, bacteria, archaea and prokarya are candidate contaminants, and unknown marks sequences Tiara could not classify precisely. Mitochondrion and plastid are expected organelle genomes, so they are not contamination.
    Note: Tiara classifies sequences of at least 3000 bases by default and advises against classifying those under 1000, so shorter sequences are left out.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ibe-uw/tiara/main/README.md and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34570171/
  column: genome
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - nunique
  secondary_layout: composition
  breakdown_col: tiara_class
  caption: sequences, by class
  headline: true

- component: figure
  title: Sequences per Tiara class
  description: |-
    Each bar counts the sequences of one assembly, coloured by the class Tiara gives them. It answers which assemblies carry sequences from other organisms.
    How to read: an assembly that is almost all eukarya is clean. A visible share of bacteria, archaea or prokarya sequences is a lead for decontamination, which FCS-GX or a BLAST check can confirm before sequences are removed.
    Source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34570171/
  visu_type: histogram
  dict_kwargs:
    x: genome
    color: tiara_class
    labels:
      genome: Assembly
      tiara_class: Tiara class

- component: interactive
  title: Tiara class
  description: |-
    Pick one or more classes to filter every tile of the dashboard to the sequences Tiara placed in them.
    How to read: select bacteria, archaea and prokarya to list the candidate contaminants of the assemblies.
  interactive_type: MultiSelect
  column_name: tiara_class

- component: table
  title: Sequence classes
  description: |-
    Each row is a classified sequence with its assembly, its merged class, the stage of the run it came from, the first-stage class, the organelle call and whether it is eukaryotic. It answers which sequences carry each class.
    How to read: filter by class to list the candidate contaminants, and by stage to compare the raw and the cleaned assembly.
